pin._src: Pins are partitioned before panes and remain outside the adaptive body.

pane.default: content for an unpinned child without pane
pane._src: sidebar + content are required for adaptive mode; inspector is optional.

shell._src: Omitted/custom preserves legacy authored layout; automatic/native opt in.

geometry.widthNormalization: min, then ideal=max(min, ideal), then max=max(ideal, max)

notes: Apple uses a real NavigationSplitView when available. Compose/Web use semantic split/stack layouts and do not claim WinUI or GTK. See OpenSource/Conformance/layout/adaptive-shell.json.
